# Every branch asks `has_variable` first. A row is drawn once a frame, and a
# comparison against a variable that is not there is an error per row per frame.
#

# **Какая грамота сидит на месте p, словами и числом.**
#
# Ячейка редактора написана под *место*, а не под грамоту: места заполняются
# подряд, так что дыр в ряду не бывает вовсе. Номер в число и в имя переводит вот
# этот диспетчер -- по одному на каждое место, тринадцать веток в каждом. Дорого
# на вид и даром на деле: обе строки рисуются раз в кадр и читают одну глобалку.

# **The charter this town held in the *saved* plan.** «Показать изменения» lists
# what left and what arrived, and until 2026-09-06 a charter moving between towns
# showed only as its buildings: «тогда уж там должна показываться вся связка —
# право, товары ушли — право, товары встали». `_save_right` is written by the
# same effect that writes `_save_goods`, so the two halves of a row are read the
# same way.
#
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_save_right_label = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 1 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 2 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_flemish_cloth_industries_right
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 3 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_artisan_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 4 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_book_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 5 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_brewing_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 6 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_jewelry_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 7 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_masonry_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 8 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_naval_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 9 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_textile_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 10 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_tooling_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = bag_wtp_save_right var:bag_wtp_save_right = 11 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_weaponry_rights
	}
	text = {

# Whether the last «+1» or «−1» did anything. **An effect that merely does
# nothing logs nothing at all**, and both of them have rules that refuse: a good
# fitting nowhere on this ground, a good down to its last building, a building
# belonging to a charter's bundle. `_edit_done` is set to 0 before the walk and
# to 1 by the walk. **The branches name the cause, and they exist because a
# single «не дало правило» was read as the mod being stubborn when it was the
# ground.** He pressed «+1» on iron: four locations of Westphalia can make iron
# and iron stood in all four, so there was nowhere for a fifth. The editor has
# only the two rules he agreed to -- never a good's last building, never a
# charter bundle's -- and it reads no quota of the plan's at all.
#
# **`_edit_fail` is the branch that had to exist and did not.** The walk used to
# say «сделано» whenever it found a location, whether or not a building actually
# went in, so a press that evicted something and then failed to place read as a
# success. It cannot happen now -- the victim goes back -- but the window must
# still say that the press did nothing, and why.
# Scope: country
# The charter `_edit_rfrom` names, in the game's own wording. A number
# reaches no name in localization, so this is the dispatch that does it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_rfrom_name = {
	type = country
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 1 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 2 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_flemish_cloth_industries_right
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 3 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_artisan_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 4 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_book_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 5 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_brewing_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 6 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_jewelry_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 7 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_masonry_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 8 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_naval_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 9 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_textile_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 10 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_tooling_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 11 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_weaponry_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 12 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_scandinavian_bergslag_privileges
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rfrom = 13 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_scandinavian_tar_privileges
	}
	text = {
		fallback = yes
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_right_unnamed
	}
}

	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 10 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_tooling_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 11 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_royal_weaponry_rights
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 12 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_scandinavian_bergslag_privileges
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rto = 13 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_right_scandinavian_tar_privileges
	}
	text = {
		fallback = yes
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_right_unnamed
	}
}

# Что сделала последняя доливка, тремя ветками.
#
# **«Не нажимали» и «нажали, а новой земли не было» -- разные ответы, и оба
# нужны.** Кнопка, которая ничего не сделала, потому что доливать нечего, и
# кнопка, которая не дошла до эффекта, на экране выглядят одинаково; строка,
# молчащая в обоих случаях, -- ровно та немота, из-за которой в этом моде уже
# терялись прогоны.
bag_wtp_edit_ext_label = {
	type = country
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_ext_ran = 0 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_ext_none
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_ext_new = 0 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_ext_empty
	}
	text = {
		fallback = yes
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_ext_done
	}
}

bag_wtp_edit_last_label = {
	type = country
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 0 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_none
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_norefill = 1 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_empty
	}
	# **What the press actually did, and this is the instrument.** «Сделано» is
	# true and useless: it cannot tell a «+1» that landed in a free room from one
	# that took a building off another good, and every rule from here on is a rule
	# about which of those happened. The four branches below name the good, the
	# location and the good that moved, off the scopes the walk parked.
	#
	# `_edit_last_done` stays as the last of them. Nothing should reach it -- a
	# finished press is op 1 or op 2 -- and if the window ever prints it, the
	# press did something these branches do not describe.
	# **Деревня называется домиком, а не товаром**, и поэтому у неё свои два
	# кода операции: одного товара, за который её ставят, у неё нет -- есть
	# здание, которое встало или ушло.
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1
			global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 5
			global_var:bag_wtp_edit_evicted = 1
		}
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_vill_over
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 5 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_vill_add
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 6 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_vill_drop
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1
			global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 1
			global_var:bag_wtp_edit_evicted = 1
		}
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_add_over
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 1 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_add_free
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 2 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_drop_refill
	}
	# **A charter press is a move and its line has to say both ends.**
	# Which charter left the town and which arrived are numbers, and a
	# number has no name -- `_edit_rfrom_name` and `_edit_rto_name` are
	# the thirteen-branch dispatches that turn them into the game's own
	# wording.
	# **Before both «сделано» branches**: the charter did move, and the
	# town could not give up enough rooms for its bundle. Half a bundle is
	# a state the player has to be told about, not one to read off a map.
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_rshort > 0 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_right_short
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 3 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_right_add
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 4 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_right_drop
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done = 1 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_done
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_reached = 0 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_lost
	}
	# **Before the goods' own refusal, because op 4 fails for its own
	# reason**: the town's charter could go, and no other charter this
	# country may grant can stand there.
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 4 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_fail = 1 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_right_noheir
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 3 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_right_notown
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 4 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_right_none
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_fail = 1 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_refill
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_fitn = 0 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_nowhere
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_cands = 0 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_novictim
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 2 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_fitn < 2 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_lastone
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op = 2 global_var:bag_wtp_edit_cands = 0 }
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_allcharter
	}
	text = {
		fallback = yes
		localization_key = bag_wtp_edit_last_refused
	}
}
